title: Second Intergenerational Climate Conversation at the Archeological Park of Ostia Antica brings young voices to the forefront of heritage adaptation
content:
The Second Intergenerational Climate Conversation, held from 27-28 October 2026 at the Archeological Park of Ostia Antica, Italy, a European Heritage Label site, brought together young people, heritage professionals, and environmental experts to explore climate adaptation measures for the heritage site.

With youth participation at its heart, the event allowed younger generations to share their perspectives, present their ideas and actively contribute to discussions on climate adaptation through workshops, presentations and site visits.

Organised within the framework of the EU-funded European Heritage Hub by ICLEI Europe, together with Project Leader Europa Nostra and partners Youth.Heritage.Europe. and the European Heritage Label Bureau, the conversation connected local experiences with wider European perspectives, highlighting the importance of empowering young people to take an active role in safeguarding cultural heritage and building climate resilience.
